text:
raj_infra: Hey team — onboarding a new partner workload 'kernelbench' in ap-east-4. They need dedicated accelerator capacity for a short pilot next week. Can someone kick off quota/eni/snat increases?

alicia_prod: Timeline? how many instances of each type? any subnet constraints?

raj_infra: Pilot window is Mon-Wed next week. Expected steady throughput ~10 GPU-hours/sec (spiky). Requesting initial pool so we don't hit throttles while we warm caches. Numbers below (per-account). Need public/private subnet prep and SNAT for burst egress.

raj_infra: ```
region: ap-east-4
account: kernelbench-prod (acct-99234)
requested: p5.xlarge: 8
           p4d.24xlarge: 4
           g5.48xlarge: 12
ENI quota: 300
SNAT EIPs: 5
Notes: tag all instances with team:kernelbench and cost-center:partners
```

kevin_cloudops: @raj_infra thanks. I'll open the support case once you confirm subnets and whether they need dedicated NAT GW vs shared. Shared NAT may rate limit their egress.

raj_infra: We prefer dedicated NATGW per team for predictable perf. Subnets will be existing ap-east-4-prod-A/B (private) — I'll add the CIDR and subnet IDs in the support ticket.

chloe_net: ENI 300 seems high — what's the expected pod/worker model? are they using multi-instance multi-pod per GPU?

raj_infra: kernelbench runs 4 containers per node, short-lived workloads. We prefer overshoot to avoid ENI bottlenecks. If we must trim, drop ENI to 220 and keep SNAT 5.

maria_sre: Also call out desired soft/hard quota change and whether this is permanent or temporary. Ops prefers temporary + review after pilot to avoid long-term entitlement inflation.

raj_infra: Good point. Marking temporary for 30 days then review. Support case description will say 30-day pilot.

kevin_cloudops: Opening AWS case now. Summary in ticket: "ap-east-4 requested accelerator & ENI bump for acct-99234 kernelbench pilot (30d)". Will post case ID shortly.

infra-bot: Case opened: AWS-CASE-2026-AP-EAST4-00987. Initial reply ETA 48-72hrs.

alicia_prod: rough cost estimate for the 30-day window? partners need to sign-off.

raj_infra: Very rough: if fully used, p5 @ spot/discounts ~= $XXX/hr, p4d heavy. I'll ping finance for exact numbers but estimate ~ $120k for 30d if fully saturated. We'll add a spend ceiling.

kevin_cloudops: Noted. I added tags and requested support for both instance quotas and ENI/SNAT. Also asked for entitlement to be temporary with rollback at 30d.

chloe_net: Two asks for networking team: 1) confirm dedicated NAT GW provisioning 2) ensure route tables/proxy egress allow partner telemetry to reach monitoring endpoints (they push to prometheus endpoint external).

maria_sre: @chloe_net I'll hand off egress checks to you. If NATGW is allocated, make sure we add CloudWatch flow logs for first 72hrs.

raj_infra: Thanks. I'll attach subnet IDs and the kernelbench onboarding doc to the AWS case. Will follow up once we get approval. :thumbsup:

kevin_cloudops: AWS replied asking for AZ spread justification and quotas per AZ — they want to avoid single-AZ hoarding. I sent an updated table.

raj_infra: Update table pasted to case: 2 p5 in az-a, 2 p5 in az-b, 4 g5 spread across az-a/b, 4 p4d across az-a/b.

infra-bot: AWS updated case AWS-CASE-2026-AP-EAST4-00987: "Request being reviewed by regional accelerator team".

alicia_prod: If AWS pushes back on p5 numbers, we can stage: start with 4 p5 + existing g5 pool and ask for emergency burst. Keep us posted.

raj_infra: Will do. If they need justification I can provide workload traces and peak queue depth.

kevin_cloudops: I'll update the ticket with the staging plan and ask for provisional quota so we can start canary runs.

maria_sre: Also please add a rollback plan in case we see noisy neighbors or sustained egress that violates our SLOs.

raj_infra: Added rollback: scale-to-zero policy + automatic job queue drain + tag-based drain scripts.

chloe_net: I'll provision NAT GW and patch route tables once case is approved. Expect ~2-4hrs to flip.

raj_infra: Appreciate it. I'll post a short checklist for launch day.

kevin_cloudops: Case still in review as of 1778802745. I'll ping if we get an approval earlier.

alicia_prod: :eyes: thanks all.
